limitations: This is a frozen current API before the two new6.FM reports; they must be reported separately.
No paid calls, no twenty-report re-audit, no original score or application/config changes.
Current known errors may be safely withheld, repaired or component-limited; that is not a new unseen accuracy estimate.

Original fact objects are multi-assertion units. One or several erroneous metrics make one fact error; the same economic metric may occur in two otherwise distinct facts. Therefore object accuracy is not metric accuracy.
Original supplemental selection uses frozen identities plus core/risk/repair union, not an unbiased market-wide estimate.

scoring_reproduction.formula: For each company: ((set(supported) union set(error.fact_id)) minus declared semantic duplicates); error wins; count exact stock+work+fact once. Sum companies. Recompute400 supplemental union including6 approved extension; match20 original runtime file hashes and every retained fact hash.
